scenes.heading: Going live
scenes.sub: Space, the arrows, and choosing an item
scenes.say: Going live, and moving through the slides.

scenes.heading: Space moves on
scenes.say: The slide in the red frame is on air. Press Space, or the right arrow, to move on. The left arrow goes back one. A clicker sends the same keys.

scenes.heading: Look ahead
scenes.say: On the right, Next shows what Space will put up, and the notes are for you, never for the room. Below, every slide of the item is laid out.

scenes.heading: Choose another item

callouts.label: Click a slide to show it now

scenes.say: To jump to another item, hold Shift and press Down. That only chooses it. The room still sees the old slide. Press Enter to start it, or click any slide to show it at once.

scenes.heading: Songs and decks
items: A deck's builds: one Space each
scenes.say: In a song, the number keys jump to that verse, and C jumps to the chorus. In a slide deck, each press of Space plays the next build, until the slide is complete.

scenes.heading: Your turn
scenes.action: Press Space, then run the practice items
scenes.say: Your turn. Press Space, and run the practice items as if it were Sunday.
